title: Gender Biases in LLMs: Higher intelligence in LLM does not necessarily solve gender bias and stereotyping.

bias_targets.methodology: Using a persona-based framework with unisex names to prompt LLMs to generate professional personas, and then analyzing the disparities in assigned competency scores, career success probabilities (e.g., becoming a founder or CEO), personality traits, and likings across the generated male, female, and non-binary profiles.
